result.title: SIDUMN: Self-Supervised Image Denoising Under Symmetric Multiplicative Noise
result.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
result.summary: Self-supervised denoising is challenging when the corruption is multiplicative and signal-dependent. In this letter, we propose SIDUMN, a symmetric noisier framework for self-supervised denoising under mean-one symmetric multiplicative noise. Given noisy observations and the noise law, the method samples an independent synthetic noise factor from the same law and constructs two complementary noisier images by applying the factor and its reflection about one. The denoising network is trained to predict one noisier image from the other, and at inference the reconstructions of $K$ such antithetic pairs are averaged. We show that the population target of the training loss is the clean conditional mean minus a multiplicative cross-term. We further prove that, for any trained network, antithetic averaging never increases the expected squared error of a single noisier-input reconstruction. Numerical results validate the theoretical findings and the proposed method.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SIDUMN：针对均值一对称乘性噪声，从同一噪声分布采样噪声因子及其关于 1 的反射，构造两张互补的加噪图像，训练网络由其一预测另一，推理时对 K 对反演重建取平均，并分析训练目标的总体偏差与反演平均不增大期望平方误差的性质。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「成对互补采样＋重建平均」可作为降低 Monte Carlo 估计方差的采样聚合思路，可能为多种 latent 假设或视觉证据的采样组合与平均提供核查线索，但与 VLM 推理无直接关系，迁移价值需自行判断。
